title: Workspace
description: The facts your AI employees quote to customers. Change one here and every channel is consistent within a minute.
unavailable: The workspace facts could not be loaded just now.
stale: Someone else saved this while you were editing. Reload to see their version.
noProfile: This workspace has no business profile yet. Finish onboarding first.

hours.disabled: Set, but switched off — GOTCHA answers at any hour
hours.oneRange: One opening and one closing time per day. A split shift — open, closed for lunch, open again — has nowhere to be stored, so it cannot be set here.
hours.noHolidays: There is no holiday calendar. Israeli holidays and eves are not applied automatically, and a one-off closure for a specific date cannot be saved — GOTCHA has a weekly pattern and nothing else.
hours.messagePlaceholder: We're closed now — someone will reply when we open.
hours.messageHint: Left empty, GOTCHA says when you next open, worked out from the week above.

language.replies: Customers are answered in their own language, whichever they write in.

languageNote: One language is stored. A second has nowhere to go yet, so this is what the knowledge documents are tagged with.

voice.title: How GOTCHA should sound
voice.unavailable: The voice could not be loaded just now.
voice.placeholder: Open with היי and the customer's first name. Keep replies to two sentences unless they asked for detail…
voice.help: Instructions to whoever is writing, not adjectives. "Open with the customer's name" is usable; "warm and approachable" is not.
voice.sourceLearned: Learned from your own past messages
voice.sampleTitle: A real reply, written the way you've chosen
voice.sampleEmpty: Write some guidance and a sample will appear here.
voice.sampleUnavailable: A sample can't be generated right now. Your guidance is unaffected.
voice.revert: Clear and let GOTCHA learn it again
voice.reverted: Handed back to the learner. GOTCHA will work this out again from your own messages.

claims.title: Never say
claims.unavailable: The rules could not be loaded just now.
claims.empty: No rules yet. These are hard limits GOTCHA will not cross.
claims.placeholder: Promise a delivery date the carrier hasn't given
claims.full: That's the limit — {max} rules. Remove one to add another.

provenance.heading: Where these details came from
provenance.unusable: We looked and could not read this from your site.

nothingAttributed.lead: Nothing is marked yet, and a scan cannot mark it.
nothingAttributed.body: These details were set up before GOTCHA recorded where each one came from, so a scan will ask you about every change rather than applying any. Accepting a suggestion records the value as yours, so it will ask again next time — a field can only be refreshed silently once a scan has written it, and none has.

provenance.someAttributed: A scan refreshes the fields marked “From your website” on its own. Anything you entered stays as you left it, and you are asked before it changes.
provenance.oneLanguage: The AI replies in each customer's own language — that is a fixed rule, and this setting does not change it. GOTCHA stores one language here, and it is used to tag your knowledge documents.

website.notSet: Not set. GOTCHA learned what it knows from your website, so without one there is nothing to scan.
website.readOnly: Changed when you reconnect your store, not here.

intro.withSite: Most of this was filled in from {domain} when you signed up. Scanning again only updates fields marked “From website”.
intro.noSite: Most of this was filled in when you signed up.

languages.heading: Languages
languages.unavailable: We could not read your conversation languages just now.
languages.none: No conversations in the last {days} days, so there is nothing to measure yet.
languages.undetected: {count} conversations whose language was not worked out. They are counted in the total.
languages.thinSample: Too few conversations to give percentages that would mean anything, so these are counts.
languages.replies: GOTCHA replies to each customer in the language they wrote in. That is a fixed rule and nothing on this screen changes it.
languages.unstored: {languages} did not come from your stored language. Nothing is wrong — replies still went out in the right language — but it is worth knowing which markets are writing to you.
languages.system: Summaries, briefs and notes to your team are written in {locale}.
languages.systemUnknown: We could not read the workspace language.
languages.mine: You personally see the interface in {locale}.
languages.mineUnset: You have not chosen an interface language, so you see the workspace's.
languages.notStorable: Which languages GOTCHA should answer in is not a setting yet — one language is stored, and it is used to tag your knowledge documents rather than to choose a reply.
